name: nefantaris-editor
description: Electron app for editing Nefantaris content with all git plumbing hidden
author: Adam Sturge

scripts.dev:app: npm run build:electron && concurrently -k "npm run dev" "wait-on http-get://localhost:5173 && VITE_DEV_SERVER_URL=http://localhost:5173 electron ."
scripts.test:e2e: npm run build && npm run build:electron && npm run test:e2e --prefix e2e
scripts.test:e2e:ui: npm run build && npm run build:electron && npm run test:e2e:ui --prefix e2e
scripts.test:e2e:report: cd e2e && allure generate ./allure-results --clean && allure open
scripts.setFormatToPrecommitHook:
echo "#!/bin/bash

STAGED_JS_FILES=\$(git diff --cached --name-only --diff-filter=ACM | grep -E '\.(tsx?|js)\$' || true)

if [ -n "\$STAGED_JS_FILES" ]; then
  echo "\$STAGED_JS_FILES" | xargs npx prettier --write --ignore-unknown || exit 1
  echo "\$STAGED_JS_FILES" | xargs npx eslint --fix || exit 1
  echo "\$STAGED_JS_FILES" | xargs git add
fi" > .git/hooks/pre-commit && chmod +x .git/hooks/pre-commit
